title: Customer Enablement Manager
status: Official employer-hosted posting available 2026-11-09; reconfirm before applying
source: Mural/Ashby employer listing checked 2026-11-09; candidate-created work sample
headline: Customer learning that accelerates time to value
thesis: Design a scaled customer learning system with evidence-linked onboarding, modular learning paths, scenario-based labs, adoption signals and targeted interventions for customers with low proficiency or delayed activation.
requirements: Execute self-guided live cohort-based and peer-led customer education
Build adaptive learning journeys by role, product use case and milestone
Produce courses guides videos templates and interactive simulations
Collaborate with Product Marketing and Customer Success on launches
Measure learner engagement proficiency and product adoption
Enable Customer Success colleagues using reusable materials
phases: Map primary customer personas, onboarding friction and existing content inventory
Role and use-case learning map, baseline adoption measurement plan
Build a small interactive education lab and reusable learning library
Modular sample academy, cohort session and success metrics dashboard
Run a measured enablement pilot and iterate based on adoption signals
Pilot retrospective, intervention playbook, 90-day customer education roadmap

references.label: Official Mural Customer Enablement Manager role

employer_needs.need: Make customer education scalable across self-guided, live, cohort and peer-led programs
employer_needs.prototype_feature: Persona-based learning pathway planner with self-guided modules, cohort schedule and reusable curriculum blocks
employer_needs.success_metric: Learning activation, completion and time to first productive use case
employer_needs.candidate_fit: Reported STEM curriculum development, instructional program leadership and staff coaching are directly transferable; B2B SaaS enablement leadership needs deeper evidence
employer_needs.open_question: Which learner personas and use cases have the largest current education gap?

employer_needs.need: Reduce customer time-to-value and improve adoption of high-priority Mural workflows
employer_needs.prototype_feature: Interactive onboarding scenario showing friction points, intervention choices and modeled time-to-value
employer_needs.success_metric: Time to first value, key-feature activation and observed product adoption
employer_needs.candidate_fit: Experience tracking learning mastery and customer lifecycle progression suggests useful approach; no real Mural telemetry or customer data is available
employer_needs.open_question: Which events define a successful first outcome for new Mural users?

employer_needs.need: Keep educational content, product releases and global Customer Success enablement aligned
employer_needs.prototype_feature: Content gap register linking launch changes to academy assets, internal CS readiness and measured learner proficiency
employer_needs.success_metric: Coverage of release-critical training and proficiency checks completed
employer_needs.candidate_fit: Reported curriculum management and multi-team operational execution support a launch-to-learning cadence; global product enablement remains a stretch
employer_needs.open_question: Which team currently owns versioning and effectiveness measurement for customer-facing education?
